summary.en:
- 
- When [[character:blade]] uses his Skill, he consumes his HP and enters the Hellscape state. In this state, he deals more damage, increases his chance of getting hit, and enhances his Basic ATK, which will consume his HP when used and deal Blast damage. His Enhanced Basic ATK will not generate SP and he will exit the Hellscape state after 3 turns.
- When his HP reduces or he takes damage, he gains 1 Charge. When he obtains 5 Charge, [[character:blade]] unleashes an AoE Follow-Up ATK, gains 15 Energy, and heals himself.
- When using his Ultimate, he sets his HP to 50% of his max HP and deals Blast damage based on his Max HP and the tallied HP that he lost during the battle.

details.en:
- E1 allows [[character:blade]]'s Enhanced Basic ATK and Ultimate to deal additional damage based on 150% of his lost tallied HP.
- S1 is one of his best options, but he has great alternative options.
